pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, predominantly sub-rounded to polygonal dark regions with soft, low-contrast edge gradients due to image resolution. Patch density is higher on the upper dorsal-lateral region compared to the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways. Intersections mostly form tri- or quad-nodal junctions with variable pixel thickness throughout the visible flank area.
